name: Shaft alignment
equation: offset / angular misalignment → vibration at 1× and 2×

name: Electrical power
equation: P = V·I; P = I²·R; P = √3·V·I·cos φ

name: Phase
equation: φ between v and i; 120° between lines

name: Heat generation and temperature rise
equation: P = I²·R; ΔT = P·R_th; τ = R_th·C_th

name: Wear and life
equation: contact erosion per operation; spring cycles; L10

name: Safety categories and performance levels
equation: ISO 13849-1 Cat B–4, PL a–e; stop categories 0/1/2

name: Inductive kick and coil suppression
equation: v = −L·di/dt at turn-off; diode clamps to V_f, MOV to V_clamp

name: Contact bounce
equation: contact makes and breaks for t_bounce after closing

name: Minimum switching current (dry circuit)
equation: below I_min at V_min the contact film is not broken: R_c ↑

name: Dielectric strength and isolation
equation: withstand voltage between coil, poles and open contacts

name: Utilization categories and arc erosion
equation: AC-1 / AC-3 / AC-4: the current a contact may make and break falls as the load's break current rises; erosion per operation follows the broken current

name: Short-circuit coordination (type 1 / type 2)
equation: the protective device clears the fault before the contactor is destroyed (type 1) or welds (type 2)

name: Reliability statistics B10 / B10d
equation: B10: operations until 10 % have failed; B10d: until 10 % have failed dangerously (IEC 60947-4-1 Annex K, ISO 13849)

name: Phase-loss sensitivity
equation: unequal heating of the three bimetals moves a differential slide: a lost phase trips faster than a balanced overload

name: Ambient temperature compensation
equation: a fourth bimetal outside the current path cancels the ambient's bending; above its range the rated current is derated

name: Thermal memory and recovery time
equation: after a trip the bimetals must cool before reset; a warm relay trips in about a quarter of the cold time
